description_en: Creates a digital watermarking embedding task
description_zh: 创建数字水印嵌入任务
kebab_example: aliyun csas create-wm-embed-task --wm-type PureDocument --filename abc0000.pdf --file-url https://example.com/abc0000.pdf --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWmEmbedTask

parameters.help_en:
The watermark type. Valid values:
PureDocument: document watermark.
PureImage: image watermark.
PureAudio: audio watermark.
PureVideo: video watermark.
AigcDocument: AIGC document watermark.
AigcImage: AIGC image watermark.
AigcAudio: AIGC audio watermark.
AigcVideo: AIGC video watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印类型。取值：
PureDocument：文档水印。
PureImage：图片水印。
PureAudio：音频水印。
PureVideo：视频水印。
AigcDocument：AIGC文档水印。
AigcImage：AIGC图片水印。
AigcAudio：AIGC音频水印。
AigcVideo：AIGC视频水印
parameters.name: wm_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the file to be embedded. The backend validates the file type based on the file name extension
parameters.help_zh: 待嵌入文件的文件名，后端需要根据文件名的后缀判断校验文件类型
parameters.name: filename

parameters.help_en: The URL for downloading the file to be embedded. The URL must be active for public network access
parameters.help_zh: 可用于下载待嵌入文件的URL，需要可以公网访问
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: The bit width of the watermark information capacity. Default value: 32. This parameter must be consistent between embedding and extraction. For example, if the 40-bit SDK is used for embedding, set this parameter to 40 during extraction as well
parameters.help_zh: 水印信息的容量位宽，默认为32。该参数嵌入和提取时需要保持一致。比如嵌入时使用的是 40 位的SDK，那么提取时也需要将该值设为 40
parameters.name: wm_info_size

parameters.help_en: The watermark information in decimal number format. If this parameter is set, WmInfoBytesB64 cannot be set
parameters.help_zh:
10进制数字格式水印信息。若设置该值，则 WmInfoBytesB64 不能设置。

取值范围取决于 WmInfoSize 参数：

当 WmInfoSize 为32时，取值范围为 1~4294967295。

当 WmInfoSize 为40时，取值范围为 1~1099511627775。

当 WmInfoSize 为64时，取值范围为 1~18446744073709551615
parameters.name: wm_info_uint

parameters.help_en: The watermark information in Base64-encoded string format. If this parameter is set, WmInfoUint cannot be set
parameters.help_zh: Base64 编码后的字符串格式水印信息 。若设置该值，则 WmInfoUint 不能设置
parameters.name: wm_info_bytes_b64

parameters.help_en:
Video watermark parameter. Specifies whether to use the long video watermark SDK. Valid values:

true: The long video watermark SDK is used.
false: The long video watermark SDK is not used.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
视频水印参数：是否使用长视频水印SDK，默认为false。取值：

true: 是
false: 否
parameters.name: video_is_long

parameters.help_en: The short video watermark parameter that specifies the video bitrate. By default, the video bitrate is automatically obtained. You can use this parameter to forcibly specify the bitrate used during extraction. Typically, you do not need to set this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 短视频水印参数：含义为视频的比特率，默认会自动获取视频的比特率，可以通过该参数强制指定提取时使用的比特率。通常无需设置该参数
parameters.name: video_bitrate

parameters.help_en: The image watermark parameter. A larger value indicates higher robustness but lower visual quality. Default value: 2. Valid values: 0 to 4
parameters.help_zh: 图像水印参数：更大的值意味着更高的鲁棒性，但是视觉质量会下降。默认值2。取值：0~4
parameters.name: image_embed_level

parameters.help_en: The image watermark parameter that specifies the expected JPEG compression quality factor of the output image. Default value: 95. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 图像水印参数：期望的输出图像jpeg压缩质量因子，默认值 95。取值：1~100
parameters.name: image_embed_jpeg_quality

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable invisible watermark embedding. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用嵌入暗水印。默认为true。
取值：
true：是
false：否
parameters.name: invisible_enable

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to add a background invisible watermark. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否添加背景暗水印。取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: bg_add_invisible

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the background visible watermark. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否启用背景明水印。取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: bg_add_visible

fields.help_en: The opacity parameter of the background invisible watermark. Valid values: 1 to 13. A larger value indicates less transparency
fields.help_zh: 背景暗水印透明度参数。取值范围1~13。取值越大，越不透明
fields.name: opacity

fields.help_en: The background invisible watermark control parameters
fields.help_zh: 背景暗水印控制参数
fields.name: bg_invisible_control

fields.help_en: The counterclockwise rotation angle of the visible watermark text. Valid values: 1 to 360
fields.help_zh: 明水印文字逆时针旋转角度。取值范围1~360
fields.name: angle

fields.help_en: The font color of the visible watermark text. The format is 0xFFFFFF RGB color format. For example, 0x000000 indicates black
fields.help_zh: 明水印文字颜色。格式为 0xFFFFFF RGB颜色格式。如 0x000000 表示黑色
fields.name: font_color

fields.help_en: The font size of the visible watermark text. A larger value indicates a larger font
fields.help_zh: 明水印文字字号。取值越大，字体越大
fields.name: font_size

fields.help_en: Takes effect when Mode is set to repeat. Specifies the number of times the visible watermark repeats horizontally
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。表示明水印在水平方向上重复出现的次数
fields.name: horizontal_number

fields.help_en: The background visible watermark mode. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
背景明水印模式。取值：

pos：在背景的特定位置嵌入一处明水印文案。
repeat：在文档背景中平铺嵌入多处明水印文案
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The opacity parameter of the visible watermark. Valid values: 1 to 255. A larger value indicates less transparency
fields.help_zh: 明水印透明度参数。取值范围1~255。取值越大，越不透明
fields.name: opacity

fields.help_en: Takes effect when Mode is set to pos. Controls the horizontal position of the visible watermark, with the lower-left corner as the origin. When the value is between 0 and 1, it represents proportional control. When the value is greater than 1, it represents precise pixel position control
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制明水印水平位置的参数，以左下角为原点。数值在0～1之间时，为比例控制。数值大于1时，为精确的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_x

fields.help_en: Takes effect when Mode is set to pos. Controls the vertical position of the visible watermark, with the lower-left corner as the origin. When the value is between 0 and 1, it represents proportional control. When the value is greater than 1, it represents precise pixel position control
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制明水印垂直位置的参数，以左下角为原点。数值在0～1之间时，为比例控制，数值大于1时，为精确的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_y

fields.help_en: Takes effect when Mode is set to repeat. Specifies the number of times the visible watermark repeats vertically
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。表示明水印在垂直方向上重复出现的次数
fields.name: vertical_number

fields.help_en: The background visible watermark text. The format is a UTF-8 string
fields.help_zh: 背景明水印文案。格式为utf8字符串
fields.name: visible_text

fields.help_en: The background visible watermark control parameters
fields.help_zh: 背景明水印控制参数
fields.name: bg_visible_control

fields.help_en: The background watermark control parameters
fields.help_zh: 背景水印控制参数
fields.name: background_control

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable component invisible watermark. The component invisible watermark can resist document addition, deletion, modification, save-as (same format), and full-select copy from docx to a new docx document. It cannot resist format conversion attacks. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否启用组件暗水印。组件暗水印可以抵抗文档增、删、改、另存（格式不变）、docx全选复制拷贝到新docx文档，不能抵抗格式转换攻击。取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: invisible_anti_all_copy

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable zero-width character invisible watermark. The zero-width character invisible watermark can resist document addition, deletion, modification, save-as (same format), partial text copy-paste, and CopytoTxt attacks. It cannot resist format conversion toPDF attacks. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否启用零宽字符暗水印。零宽字符暗水印可以抵抗文档增、删、改、另存（格式不变）、部分文本复制粘贴、CopytoTxt攻击。不能抵抗格式转换toPDF攻击。取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: invisible_anti_text_copy

fields.help_en: The timestamp watermark information bit width. Specifies how much information a single timestamp can contain. A larger value theoretically reduces the number of rows required for extraction, but increases the time modification magnitude. The magnitude range is 2^n, where n is this parameter value
fields.help_zh: 时间戳水印信息位宽。指定单个时间戳容纳多少信息，这个数越大，提取信息需要的行数理论上越少，但是修改的时间幅度变大，幅度范围是2的n次方，n为此参数值
fields.name: embed_bits_number_in_each_time

fields.help_en: The column to embed the watermark. We recommend that you use a string content column. Counting starts from 1
fields.help_zh: 指定嵌入列，建议为string内容列，计数从1开始
fields.name: embed_column

fields.help_en: The zero-width character watermark parameter that specifies the embedding density. Valid values: a floating-point number between 0 and 1. 0 indicates that only the first row is embedded. 1 indicates that all rows are embedded
fields.help_zh: 零宽字符水印参数。嵌入密度，取值在0～1之间的浮点数，0为仅嵌入第一行内容，1为所有行均嵌入
fields.name: embed_density

fields.help_en: The modification precision, which indicates the magnitude of modification as a power of 10. For example, 0 indicates a modification precision of 10^0 (the ones place), -1 indicates the first decimal place, and 1 indicates the tens place. If the float data does not have this precision, no modification is made
fields.help_zh: 修改精度，表示修改的幅度，为10的n次方，比如0表示修改精度为10^0，即个位部分，-1表示小数点后一位，1表示十位部分，若float数据无此精度的部分，则不修改
fields.name: embed_precision

fields.help_en: The timestamp watermark parameter that specifies the watermark embedding position. Valid values: Min (minute), Sec (second), and MilSec (millisecond). Select one of the three. The algorithm modifies the data at the selected position
fields.help_zh: 时间戳水印参数。水印嵌入位置。可以为Min（分）、Sec（秒）、MilSec（毫秒），三者选一个填入，选择哪个，则算法修改哪个位置的数据
fields.name: embed_time_position

fields.help_en: The watermark embedding method
fields.help_zh:
水印嵌入方式。
取值：

lossless_row_shift_embed：数据无损方法
lossy_number_embed：数据有损方法
lossy_time_stamp_embed：时间戳方法
lossy_zero_width_embed：零宽字符方法
fields.name: method

fields.help_en: The timestamp watermark parameter that specifies the format string for parsing timestamps in the CSV file. For example, if the timestamp in the CSV file is similar to "2023-10-15 13:20:59:342", the corresponding format string is "Year-Mon-Day Hour:Min:Sec.MilSec". The watermark output retains this format after embedding. If the format is incorrect, this method cannot be used. Year, month, day, hour, minute, second, and millisecond in the format string must follow the specified notation. Delimiters must be single non-alphabetic English characters, typically ":", "/", "-", or " " (space). "T" and "Z" are also supported as delimiters. Other time formats are not currently supported
fields.help_zh: 时间戳水印参数。解析csv文件中时间戳的格式字符串。若csv文件中的时间戳类似“2023-10-15 13:20:59:342”，则对应的格式字符串为“Year-Mon-Day Hour:Min:Sec.MilSec”，则这里要填“Year-Mon-Day Hour:Min:Sec.MilSec”，水印嵌入后依然按照此格式输出，一旦填错则该方法无法使用。格式字符串中的年、月、日、时、分、秒、毫秒必须按照上述写法填写，连接符为英文非字符的单连接符，一般可以是“:”“/”“-”“ ”（空格），额外支持“T”“Z”为连接符。其他形式的时间格式目前不支持解析。
fields.name: time_format

parameters.help_en: The CSV watermark embedding control parameters
parameters.name: csv_control

fields.help_en: The clockwise rotation angle of the logo watermark. Valid values: 1 to 360
fields.help_zh: Logo水印文字顺针旋转角度。取值范围1~360
fields.name: angle

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable enhanced visible watermarking. After this feature is enabled, the logo is processed so that information embedded in the logo can be extracted
fields.help_zh: 是否开启增强明水印。开启后会对logo进行处理，处理后可以对嵌入logo嵌入信息进行提取
fields.name: enhance

fields.help_en: The logo watermark in Base64 format. The logo file is a PNG image converted to Base64 format
fields.help_zh: Base64格式logo水印。Logo文件为PNG图片转成Base64格式
fields.name: logo_base64

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to bottom-left or bottom-right. The bottom margin
fields.help_zh: Mode为bottom-left、bottom-right时生效。下边距
fields.name: bottom

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to top-left or bottom-left. The left margin
fields.help_zh: Mode为top-left、bottom-left时生效。左边距
fields.name: left

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to top-right or bottom-right. The right margin
fields.help_zh: Mode为top-right、bottom-right时生效。右边距
fields.name: right

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to top-left or top-right. The top margin
fields.help_zh: Mode为top-left、top-right时生效。上边距
fields.name: top

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to top-left, top-right, bottom-left, or bottom-right. The margin settings
fields.help_zh: Mode为top-left、top-right、bottom-left、bottom-right时生效。边距
fields.name: margin

fields.help_en: The display mode of the logo watermark. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
Logo水印显示模式。取值：
pos：固定位置模式。
repeat：平铺模式。
top-left：左上模式。
top-right：右上模式。
bottom-left：左下模式。
bottom-right：右下模式
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The opacity of the logo watermark. Valid values: 1 to 255. A larger value indicates lower transparency
fields.help_zh: Logo水印透明度。取值：1~255。取值越大，透明度越低
fields.name: opacity

fields.help_en: The horizontal anchor point of the logo watermark. Valid values: 0 to 1. When (PosAx, PosAy) is set to (0, 0), the watermark is drawn with the upper-left corner as the anchor point. When the value is 0.5, the watermark is drawn at the center. When (PosAx, PosAy) is set to (1, 1), the watermark is drawn at the lower-right corner
fields.help_zh: Logo水印水平方向锚点。 取值范围0~1。(PosAx,PosAy)取值为（0,0）时，以文本左上角为锚点绘制；取值为0.5，以文本中心点位置绘制；取值为（1,1）时，以文本右下角位置绘制
fields.name: pos_ax

fields.help_en: The vertical anchor point of the logo watermark. Valid values: 0 to 1. When (PosAx, PosAy) is set to (0, 0), the watermark is drawn with the upper-left corner as the anchor point. When the value is 0.5, the watermark is drawn at the center. When (PosAx, PosAy) is set to (1, 1), the watermark is drawn at the lower-right corner
fields.help_zh: Logo水印垂直方向锚点。 取值范围0~1。(PosAx,PosAy)取值为（0,0）时，以文本左上角为锚点绘制；取值为0.5，以文本中心点位置绘制；取值为（1,1）时，以文本右下角为位置绘制
fields.name: pos_ay

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to pos. Specifies the horizontal position of the visible watermark in pixels, with the upper-left corner as the origin
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制明水印水平位置的参数，以左上角为原点的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_x

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to pos. Specifies the vertical position of the visible watermark in pixels, with the upper-left corner as the origin
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制明水印垂直位置的参数，以左上角为原点的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_y

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to repeat. Specifies the horizontal spacing for tiled visible watermarks
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。控制明水印平铺水平间距的参数
fields.name: space_x

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to repeat. Specifies the vertical spacing for tiled visible watermarks
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。控制明水印平铺垂直间距的参数
fields.name: space_y

fields.help_en: The visibility. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
可见性：

true ：  显示

false： 不显示
fields.name: visible

fields.help_en: The control parameters for logo watermarks
fields.help_zh: Logo水印控制参数
fields.name: logo_visible_control

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable this feature
fields.help_zh:
是否启用。

true ：  显示

false： 不显示
fields.name: enable

fields.help_en: The metadata in Base64 format. Encode the following string in Base64 format: AIGC:{"Label":"1","ContentProducer":"AXXXX","ProduceID":"BXXXX,"ReservedCode1":"CXXX","ContentPropagator":"DXXX","PropagateID":"EXXX","ReservedCode2":"FXXXX"}. Note: 1. The "AIGC:" prefix is required. Otherwise, the metadata cannot be added. The format differs from that of audio and video metadata. 2. The Base64 encoding must be in standard format with padding
fields.help_zh: 元信息Base64格式。需要将格式为AIGC:{"Label":"1","ContentProducer":"AXXXX","ProduceID":"BXXXX,"ReservedCode1":"CXXX","ContentPropagator":"DXXX","PropagateID":"EXXX","ReservedCode2":"FXXXX"}。的字符串编码为Base64格式字符串。 注意:1. "AIGC:"前缀需要加上，否则无法进行添加，另外需要注意与音视频的格式不同。2.Base64为标准格式需要，需要有补位
fields.name: xmp_kv_base64

fields.help_en: The metadata control parameters. This parameter takes effect when WmType is set to PureImage or AigcImage
fields.help_zh: 元信息控制参数。WmType为PureImage或AigcImage时生效
fields.name: metadata_control

fields.help_en: The clockwise rotation angle of the text watermark. Valid values: 0 to 360
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文字顺针旋转角度。取值范围0~360
fields.name: angle

fields.help_en: The font color of the text watermark. The format is 0xFFFFFF or #FFFFFF RGB color format. For example, 0x000000 or #000000 indicates black
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文字颜色。格式为 0xFFFFFF或#FFFFFF RGB颜色格式。如 0x000000或#000000 表示黑色

fields.help_en: The font size of the text watermark. A larger value indicates a larger font
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文字字号。取值越大，字体越大
fields.name: font_size

fields.help_zh: Mode为bottom-left、bottom-right时生效。下边距
fields.name: bottom

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to top-left or bottom-left. The left margin
fields.help_zh: Mode为top-left、bottom-left时生效。左边距

fields.help_zh: Mode为top-right、bottom-right时生效。右边距

fields.help_zh: Mode为top-left、top-right时生效。上边距

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to top-left, top-right, bottom-left, or bottom-right. The margin settings
fields.help_zh: Mode为top-left、top-right、bottom-left、bottom-right时生效。边距

fields.help_zh:
文本水印显示模式。取值：
pos：固定位置模式。

fields.help_zh: 文本水印透明度。取值：1~255。取值越大，越不透明

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to repeat. Specifies the horizontal spacing for tiled text watermarks
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。控制文本水印平铺水平间距的参数
